sources.title: AURORA-KITTI: Any-Weather Depth Completion and Denoising in the Wild
sources.snippet: A framework for any-weather depth completion and denoising, built upon the KITTI benchmark. Under review at Information Fusion.

sources.title: [2603.14701] AURORA-KITTI: Any-Weather Depth Completion and Denoising ...
sources.snippet: In this paper, we introduce AURORA-KITTI, the first large-scale multi-modal, multi-weather benchmark for robust depth completion in the wild. We further formulate Depth Completion and Denoising (DCD) as a unified task that jointly reconstructs a dense depth map from corrupted sparse inputs while suppressing weather-induced noise.
